US and Iran tensions escalate in West Asia

Tensions between the United States and Iran have intensified in West Asia, with the US reportedly sending a third aircraft carrier to the region as President Trump keeps military options open. Iran-backed groups have issued warnings to Iraqi forces against entering their strongholds near Baghdad. Some reports suggest Iran is drafting plans to escalate conflict, potentially emboldened by US midterm election results. The situation has been described as a deepening stalemate and a dangerous limbo, raising concerns about a potential major global crisis.
